card.name: Mixed mid-sentence words in label text
card.fires_on: No single word or setting is shared. It fires on scattered words in drug-label sentences, such as partway through renal insufficiency, 'use' after duration of, or 'the' after In animals.

modes.label: Partway through long words
modes.description: Fires on a middle piece of a longer medical word.

modes.label: Word after duration of
modes.description: Fires on 'use' ending the phrase duration of use in estrogen warnings.
modes.example: dependent upon duration of<< use>> and could last up to >10
